name: Orders database
description: Let agents look up customers' orders, add notes to them and cancel open ones, straight from the orders database.
identity: A database user for agents, allowed only what these actions need.

setup.title: Create a database user for agents
setup.body: Ask your database administrator for a user that can read orders and customers, add order notes and change an order's status, and nothing else. In the example database it already exists: user agents, password agents-example.
copy: psql -c "create role agents login password '<a strong password>'"
psql -c "grant select on customers, orders, order_notes to agents"
psql -c "grant insert on order_notes to agents"
psql -c "grant usage on sequence order_notes_id_seq to agents"
psql -c "grant update (status) on orders to agents"

capabilities.label: Read orders
capabilities.description: List a customer's orders and look up one order.

capabilities.label: Add notes
capabilities.description: Add a note to an order.

limits.label: Customers
limits.help: Only these customers' orders, by customer code. Leave empty for all.

revoke: Ask your database administrator to drop the agents user.

tools.name: erp_list_orders
tools.description: List a customer's orders, newest first. Optionally only those with one status (open, shipped or cancelled).
tools.sql: select order_no, customer_code as customer, status, total, created_on from orders where customer_code = :customer and (cast(:status as text) is null or status = :status) order by created_on desc

tools.name: erp_get_order
tools.description: Read one order by its number, with the customer's name and the order's notes.
tools.sql: select o.order_no, o.customer_code as customer, c.name as customer_name, o.status, o.total, o.created_on, (select string_agg(n.note, ' | ' order by n.id) from order_notes n where n.order_no = o.order_no) as notes from orders o join customers c on c.code = o.customer_code where o.order_no = :order_no

tools.name: erp_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to an order.
tools.sql: with o as (select order_no, customer_code from orders where order_no = :order_no), n as (insert into order_notes (order_no, note) select order_no, :note from o returning id, order_no) select n.id as note_id, n.order_no, o.customer_code as customer from n join o using (order_no)

tools.name: erp_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an open order. Shipped or already cancelled orders are left as they are (rows_affected 0).
tools.sql: update orders set status = 'cancelled' where order_no = :order_no and status = 'open' returning order_no, customer_code as customer, status
